svg.aria-label: Adelante. App Store · 1.1.0 in TestFlight. A daily quote on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, for the days you don’t feel like opening an app. Built with Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin. The screenshot shows the widgets, Today and widget editor screens of version 1.1.0.
